title: Structure of HK97 small terminase:DNA complex unveils a novel DNA binding mechanism by a circular protein
authors: Maria Chechik; Sandra J. Greive; Alfred A. Antson; Huw T. Jenkins
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析HK97小终止酶与DNA复合物结构，揭示环形蛋白通过末端片段识别DNA的新机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，虽非TF-DNA体系，但其DNA结合机制和结构建模方法对TF-DNA互作研究有借鉴价值。
abstract: DNA recognition is critical for assembly of double-stranded DNA viruses, in particular for the initiation of packaging the viral genome into the capsid. DNA packaging has been extensively studied for three archetypal bacteriophage systems: cos , pac and phi29. We identified the minimal site within the cos region of bacteriophage HK97 specifically recognised by the small terminase and determined a cryoEM structure for the small terminase:DNA complex. This nonameric circular protein utilizes a previously unknown mechanism of DNA binding. While DNA threads through the central tunnel, unexpectedly, DNA-recognition is generated at its exit by a substructure formed by the N- and C-terminal segments of two adjacent protomers of the terminase which are unstructured in the absence of DNA. Such interaction ensures continuous engagement of the small terminase with DNA, allowing sliding along DNA while simultaneously checking the DNA sequence. This mechanism allows locating and instigating packaging initiation and termination precisely at the cos site.
abstract_zh: DNA识别对于双链DNA病毒的组装至关重要，尤其是在启动病毒基因组包装进入衣壳的过程中。DNA包装已在三种典型噬菌体系统中得到广泛研究：cos、pac和phi29。我们鉴定了噬菌体HK97的cos区域内由小终止酶特异性识别的最小位点，并确定了小终止酶：DNA复合物的冷冻电镜结构。这种九聚体环状蛋白利用了一种先前未知的DNA结合机制。当DNA穿过中央通道时，出乎意料的是，DNA识别在其出口处由终止酶两个相邻原体的N端和C端片段形成的亚结构产生，这些片段在无DNA时呈无序状态。这种相互作用确保了小终止酶与DNA的持续结合，使其能够沿DNA滑动，同时检查DNA序列。该机制使得包装启动和终止能够在cos位点精确地定位和触发。
